Name: Animated Zoologist Outfit (Fashion Sense)
Author: Neopffe
Description:
[b][size=6]Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]New shirts for Fashion Sense and an optional preset to cosplay Terraria's Zoologist
[*]Shirt options [b]Static [/b](no animation), [b]Bouncy [/b](3 frame animation) or [b]Bouncier [/b](5 frame animation), with [b]alternative size[/b]
[*]Original colors or with [b]custom colors[/b] for the shirt, belt and beltbuckle
[/list][b][size=6]Requirements:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32338]Curvy Girl Redux[/url] [b](On options, change BodyType to curvy)[/b]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10324]FS - SH's Animals and Myths Pack[/url] - [b]Optional [/b]for the preset
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10294?tab=description]Shardust's Animated Hairstyles[/url] - [b]Optional [/b]for the preset
[/list][b][size=6]Instructions:[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Use Fashion Sense's Hand Mirror (Buy it from Pierre or write fs_add_mirror in SMAPI console) 
[*]Choose the shirt you want
[/list] ﻿﻿
﻿[size=4][b]How to use my optional Terraria's Zoologist Preset:
[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Install optional mods for the ears, tail and animated hair
[*]Choose skin color 15 on a new game or buying appearance change from the Wizard
[*]Use the Fashion Sense's Hand Mirror and click "Acess your Fashion Sense outfits." button
[*]Click "View presets provided by Fashion Sense content packs."
[*]Click "Zoologist"
[/list][b][size=4]
Alternative downloads:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces "[b]Oil Stained Shirt[/b]" and "[b]Cat Ears[/b]"
[*]For player [b]skin color 15 [/b]only
[*]For [b]Content Patcher[/b] only, o[b]r no mods with xnb replacer[/b]
[*]No animations and no custom colors
[/list]
I allow anyone to do absolutely whatever they want with this mod with no credits. Thanks to Luuuk for making the skin and shirt color masklayers, they also gave full permission to do whatever you want with the mod
